cues.en: Today, when carmakers add touchscreens to their new models, they often make things worse for the driver.
cues.zh: 如今，车企在新款车型中加入触屏时，往往会让驾驶体验变得更糟。

cues.en: Because they're cluttered with small intangible buttons,
cues.zh: 因为屏幕上堆满了毫无触感的小按钮，

cues.en: they're harder to control and more distracting.
cues.zh: 操作起来更难，也更容易让人分心。

cues.en: But what if it didn't have to be this way?
cues.zh: 但其实完全可以换一种方式。

cues.en: Let me show you how touch interfaces in cars could actually work.
cues.zh: 让我来向大家展示，车载触控界面究竟该如何运作。

cues.en: Instead of having a screen full of small buttons, let's make the whole thing one big control.
cues.zh: 与其铺满细小的按钮，不如把整块屏幕做成一个巨大的控制器。

cues.en: The moment you touch the screen, the interface appears right under your fingers.
cues.zh: 只要手指触碰屏幕，界面就会直接浮现在指尖下方。

cues.en: It doesn't matter where exactly your fingers are.
cues.zh: 手指落在哪里其实无关紧要。

cues.en: The interface just realigns with their position and that becomes the point of reference.
cues.zh: 界面会自动对齐手指的位置，并将其作为参考基准。

cues.en: In order to adjust the setting, all you need to do now is drag up or down.
cues.zh: 想要调节设置，你只需要上下滑动即可。

cues.en: You can do that really fast too without having to watch out to be very accurate.
cues.zh: 你可以快速完成操作，完全不需要小心翼翼去精准对齐。

cues.en: The reason why that works is because the interface is designed to be as forgiving as possible.
cues.zh: 这之所以行得通，是因为界面的容错率被设计得极高。

cues.en: Accidental sideways movements are ignored, and even moving your fingers at different speeds barely affects the outcome.
cues.zh: 误触的横向移动会被直接忽略，甚至不同滑动速度也几乎不会影响结果。

cues.en: That way, even with the smallest amount of precision, it still works.
cues.zh: 这样一来，哪怕操作精度极低，也依然有效。

cues.en: But how do you control different things if don't have multiple buttons or sliders on the screen?
cues.zh: 但如果屏幕上没有多个按钮或滑块，该怎么控制不同功能呢？

cues.en: Well, because this is a multi touch display,
cues.zh: 既然这是一块多点触控屏，

cues.en: you can invoke different controls by using different numbers of fingers.
cues.zh: 你就可以通过不同数量的手指来调用不同的控制项。

cues.en: So with two fingers, you can control the volume.
cues.zh: 比如用双指，你可以调节音量。

cues.en: With three fingers, you control the music source.
cues.zh: 三指可以切换音源。

cues.en: Four fingers control temperature.
cues.zh: 四指调节温度。

cues.en: And five fingers control airflow.
cues.zh: 五指调节风量。

cues.en: And they all follow the same principle.
cues.zh: 它们都遵循同一个逻辑。

cues.en: You place your fingers anywhere on the screen and drag up or down to make the adjustment.
cues.zh: 手指放在屏幕任意位置，上下拖动即可调节。

cues.en: And if you look closely, you'll see that each control has a different sensitivity.
cues.zh: 仔细观察的话，你会发现每个控件的灵敏度各不相同。

cues.en: The volume, for example, changes in very small steps because it's less important that you hit one specific number.
cues.zh: 比如音量是以极小的步长变化的，因为没必要非得调到某个特定数值。

cues.en: When changing the music source, however, the interface helps you to select the right one by requiring more movement to make a change.
cues.zh: 而切换音源时，界面需要更大的滑动幅度才会触发切换，帮你准确选中。

cues.en: That way you're less likely to miss.
cues.zh: 这样就不容易滑过了。

cues.en: So far this makes four things you can control,
cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经能控制四项功能了，

cues.en: but that's not enough yet. That's why this interface doesn't only react to how many fingers you use, but also to whether they're close together or far apart.
cues.zh: 但这还不够。因此，这个界面不仅能感应手指数量，还能识别手指是并拢还是张开。

cues.en: Look at what happens when you spread your fingers and touch the screen. The interface goes into a different mode again and selects a different control.
cues.zh: 看看张开手指触摸屏幕会发生什么——界面会切入另一种模式，选中不同的控制项。

cues.en: Instead of changing the volume like before,
cues.zh: 此时双指不再像之前那样调节音量，

cues.en: two fingers now let you scrub through your playlist.
cues.zh: 而是让你快速翻阅播放列表。

cues.en: And of course, this works for two, three, four, or five fingers.
cues.zh: 当然，无论是两指、三指、四指还是五指都同样适用。

cues.en: All in all, this interface gives you easy control over eight different settings.
cues.zh: 总之，这个界面能让你轻松掌控八种不同的设置。

cues.en: And it does that without you having to take your eyes off the road because you're being distracted trying to hit that one small button on the screen.
cues.zh: 而且它能做到这一点，让你不用把视线移开路面，免得为了去点屏幕上那个小按钮而分心。
